title: Text models get new routes and versions
summary:
Text and image models got a tune-up, browser SDK calls cleared CORS preflight, and the app showcase got a tidy-up.

`kimi` ultimately moved to Kimi K2.5 with image input and a 262K-token context window. `glm` moved to GLM 5.1, `qwen-large` to Qwen3.6 Plus, and `deepseek` and `minimax` received provider routing changes. Step 3.5 Flash was added and then removed from the model registry the same day.

The default image model changed from Sana Sprint 0.6B to 1.6B on a GH200 worker. The setup reports roughly 0.165 seconds per image, compared with 0.25 seconds on the previous A100 worker. Individual dimensions can now reach 768 pixels, subject to a 512×512 total-pixel cap.

Enter now reflects requested CORS headers, allowing browser-based OpenAI SDK calls to `/v1/chat/completions` that include telemetry headers such as `x-stainless-os`.

daily.text: Sana Sprint now defaults to the 1.6B image model. Its new worker reports roughly 0.165 seconds per image, down from 0.25 seconds on the previous setup. [Try image generation](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/{prompt}).
